# Marino Group

> Marino Group is a local real estate team in Naples, Florida, brokered by Waterfront Realty Group, Inc. The team helps families buy, sell, and build homes across Southwest Florida: Collier, Lee, and Charlotte counties.

## Key facts

- Business: Marino Group (Jorge Marino LLC), a real estate team with Waterfront Realty Group, Inc. as broker
- Based in: Naples, Florida
- Areas served: Naples, Golden Gate Estates, Marco Island, Bonita Springs, Estero, Fort Myers, Lehigh Acres, Cape Coral, Port Charlotte
- Languages: English, Spanish, Russian
- Phone (call or text): (239) 776-2393
- Email: dhomeswfl@gmail.com
- Website: https://marinogroupswfl.com/
- Approach: "We put people before transactions." No sale is promised; the team promises hard work and a clear strategy.

## Services

- [Home search](https://marinogroupswfl.com/homes/): homes for sale across Southwest Florida, with local filters such as Gulf access, no bridges and no HOA
- [Area guides](https://marinogroupswfl.com/areas/): neighborhood guides for each city the team serves
- Selling a home: free consultation, pricing from recent comparable sales, and a six-step plan from consultation to closing
- Building a new home: home models through a licensed builder partner, with help on the lot, financing and build
- [Wooden Concept Renovations](https://marinogroupswfl.com/woodenconcept/): kitchen remodeling, custom cabinets, vanities, closets and finish carpentry in Naples, FL. Phone (239) 821-9261
- [Marino Design](https://marinogroupswfl.com/marinodesign/): AI virtual staging for listing photos
- [Marino Showings](https://marinogroupswfl.com/showings/): licensed agents cover buyer showings and open houses for other agents
